correctness.rationale: Part 1 reconstructs the generated-quandle identity using invertible right translations on the finite closure and T-invariance of differences. Parts 2–3 use canonical Fitting decomposition and nilpotence of U to show surjective quotient differences imply the nilpotent part is fully generated. Parts 3–4 prove the precise independent coverage+module-spanning criterion and count independent quotient heads using finite-module simple quotients/CRT. The exact k boundary and trivial case are handled; 9 independently enumerated finite quandle families validate the predicted fractions without serving as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The law gives an exact infinite-family quandle generation invariant for every finite Alexander quandle, motivated by the recent complete graph component theorem. A sharp minimal generator number and a factorization separating global component coverage from residue-field module complexity handle non-Latin, mixed-prime and nonsemisimple cases. This cannot be recovered from component number alone, demonstrated by nilpotent and connected quadratic examples, and supports exact sampling/generation computations for previously untreated parameter families.
